values.note: Campspot sells 78 RV sites nightly (57 + 2 Standard, 9 Full Hook-Up, 10 Premium waterfront; site lengths to 38-40 ft) and 10 primitive tent sites. County rules: every camper backs in, hitch facing the road; one RV, one small tent and two vehicles per site. Seasonal and monthly sites are also sold (share not stated).

sites.source: https://www.campspot.com/book/crittenden-park (Campspot park record: site types and max lengths 38/40 ft, read 2026-10-13) + 2026 rate sheet PDF ('All campers must be backed into the campsite with hitch facing the road'; 'one recreational unit per site, one small tent and two vehicles'; Seasonal/Monthly rates), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Reserve on Campspot (or call the park); taken up to 6 months ahead and paid in full when booked. Premium sites: 3-night minimum on weekends and holidays, 15 nights maximum per season; other sites 1 month maximum.

booking.source: https://www.osceola-county.org/residents/county_departments/parks/ ('Reservations will be taken up to 6 months in advance'; 'Click below for Crittenden Park reservations ... www.campspot.com/book/crittenden-park') + 2026 rate sheet PDF ('All Sites must be paid in full when making a reservation'; '15-night Maximum stay on Premium sites per season'; '3-night minimum stay on premium sites weekends & holidays'; '1-month Maximum stay on Non-Premium sites'), read 2026-10-22

summary: County page + 2026 rate sheet (approved 2026-05-05) re-read: season May 1 - Sep 26, 2026, $27 standard / $33 full hookup and premium, $5 booking fee, $8/day vehicle permit all match the entry (no resident/non-resident split posted, so nothing to move).
